column4:

column3: Marbelle Hotel, NW 8th Street by the interstate, South Crosstown. Enter from the back.
column4:
Upstairs, go through the door that opens on its own, then read the note on the roof. Return to the ground-floor safe and enter 955214. Separate Casa Guardia gang operation in Little Cuba also reports a Crowex Ambassador; its relationship to the Breakfast variant and collection credit is unverified. Reported $234 cash; opening the safe is reported to end the temporary fog. The Casa Guardia alternate report places an Ambassador beside gloves on a workshop bench reached from the upper office. Another map marker describes an upstairs table; confirm the exact variant before treating it as the Breakfast model. The Casa Guardia GPS pin is now assigned to ID 5190, not this hotel watch. Vice City Hustle corroborates the ground-floor safe and 955214 code; its cash estimate differs from the earlier report. The Nov 25 watch roundup distinguishes the Casa Guardia Ambassador from the hotel Breakfast in its location list; whether the two award separate wardrobe credit remains open. Wardrobe screenshots show a gold/white Crowex Ambassador for Lucia; the Breakfast versus Casa Guardia credit remains unresolved.
Casa Guardia route: use the empty lot and ladders to the roof, then the hatch; this is an alternate Ambassador report, not a confirmed Breakfast pickup.
County (reported area): Vice-Dale.
Leonipedia reports the Breakfast variant can be worn by either protagonist; this does not establish that the Casa Guardia report is the same collectible.
The separate Casa Guardia pickup is now tracked as reported location ID 5190; independent style credit remains unresolved.
VGC confirms the hotel Breakfast variant and ground-floor safe. The same guide reports the safe can be opened with the known code without completing the rooftop fog sequence; the exact cash amount is not stated.
WikiGTAVI Crosstown entry places six-digit clue on roof pamphlet; not merely second floor.
VicePulse places the same code and model near Downtown NE 2nd / 1st Ave; conflicts with corroborated Marbelle Hotel location. Do not relocate the marker.

column3: Saber Shipping Facility, Balsero, near the Rockridge border. Climb the stacked containers left of the gate, take the yellow lift to the roof and enter the unlocked stair door. Look on the table near the safe-code board.
column4:
B&G Ark Royal Ashore (white gold / sapphire pave) is a key valuable of this Guardia Brothers operation. Another reported pickup is Southside Trap House; these are alternate locations for the same watch model, not two separate collection credits. Both linked operation sites are reported for the same model. Look for the gold pickup indicator. Other reported copies are in a safe in Capri and on the dresser opposite the bed in Waning Sands. Another Ark Royal Ashore is reported on a bedroom dresser in Waning Sands; compare collection credit. Additional map sites identify Ashore near Belpoint Lighthouse and a Welcome Sign, plus the Waning Sands Marina area and a Salton gang hideout. These are alternate sightings, not new model slots. District VI also reports an Ashore on a bedroom dresser in Ambrosia; verify the model and whether already unlocked. Other single-source Ashore reports place a watch in an unnamed suburban garage-access house and upstairs in a western Kelly County villa. Neither is established as a separate model or mapped pickup. Wardrobe screenshots report white gold/sapphire and rose gold/black Ashore finishes; do not count each finish as a separate pickup without in-game credit.
At Saber Shipping the watch table is reported near the open safe; the Southside Trap House report identifies the watch as the key valuable.
A guide lists the Southside Trap House watch as its sole Key Valuable; check separate operation completion without assuming another style unlock.
At the alternate Southside Trap House site, the reported Ashore pickup is in the kitchen on the right-hand side; finish not specified.
Compare provisional watch entrance lead 4112 (Xero Car Wash / Southside) before assigning a separate watch identity.
Alternate Waning Sands report (gta6map.city): leave the freeway at the intersection south of Waning Sands; in the residential pocket, go through the door beside the last bed into the next room. This differs from the dresser report; verify which house and finish. The GTA6 Maps Waning Sands Marina entry is approximately 480 m from the marina.
GTA Town independently describes the Waning Sands Ashore pickup as a dresser opposite the bed. Its Balsero watch marker describes a room upstairs containing a safe, but does not identify the model; compare Saber Shipping and Carrier Warehouse before assigning it.
Vice City Hustle reports another Ashore pickup in the Southside Trap House, its sole key valuable. The finish and whether both count independently still require verification.
WikiGTAVI reports an additional Ashore on the bedroom dresser in Waning Sands, opposite the bed, plus a Capri upstairs bedroom pickup; independent credit unknown.
Alternate report: a copy of the Ashore watch is in the Southside Trap House kitchen, on the right; verify model label before checking the existing watch.
Nov 27 watch roundup distinguishes white-gold/sapphire Ashore at Saber Shipping from an Ashore in the Southside kitchen and a black-ceramic airport report. Model/finish credit requires in-game confirmation.
VicePulse video index (Nov 26): Belpoint yacht safe, clue behind painting (731997); airport Lost & Found staff office; Marney Cir dresser near Belville. All reported Ashore copies; separate style credit unknown.
